title: Read browser diagnostics
responsibility: Read and validate the browser diagnostics written for one check attempt.

inputs.name: readBrowserDiagnostics.directory
inputs.description: Directory used for this check attempt; the function reads only its browser-errors.ndjson child and returns no diagnostics when that file is absent.

outputs.name: readBrowserDiagnostics
outputs.description: Contains parsed diagnostics from each nonblank line when the file is present and within the size limit; a missing or empty file returns {}, while a nonregular file, a file over 2,000,000 bytes, or any read, JSON, or schema error returns a failure string without partial records.

examples.failure: Browser diagnostics could not be read or did not match their schema.

errors.message: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined
